name: esp32-spwm-hub75
description: ESP32-S3 driver for S-PWM HUB75 LED panels (ICND1065L and similar). These panels take one 16-bit greyscale word per pixel per colour and do their own PWM, so binary-code-modulation libraries cannot drive them. Uses LCD_CAM + GDMA, so the entire waveform is in the DMA stream and no CPU stall can disturb the scan.
keywords: hub75, led-matrix, esp32-s3, spwm, icnd1065l, lcd_cam, gdma, dma
